description.en: Runs a full "stand event" dialogue exchange between two characters: turns them to face each other (unless already turning), enters stand-event mode, positions their hi-detail dialogue models, fades them in, shows the message, fades them out, and exits stand-event mode.
Message ID to show via CreateSpeech.
Low-detail handle of the main speaker (used for turning), or 0 to skip turning.
Hi-detail dialogue model handle of the main speaker.
Standard dialogue position slot for the main speaker (e.g. EV_CHARA_POS_RIGHT).
3-element motion ID array for the main speaker's hi model.
Base model ID for the main speaker's hi model positioning.
Low-detail handle of the NPC speaker (used for turning), or 0 to skip turning.
Hi-detail dialogue model handle of the NPC speaker.
Standard dialogue position slot for the NPC speaker.
3-element motion ID array for the NPC speaker's hi model.
Base model ID for the NPC speaker's hi model positioning.
Optional turn-angle override for the main speaker (defaults to -1, auto).
Optional turn-angle override for the NPC speaker (defaults to -1, auto).
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Run a full stand-event dialogue exchange between the player and an NPC
StandEventRun("tlk_42011400a", hTenmaL, hTenmaH, EV_CHARA_POS_RIGHT, [0, 0, 0], "", hAkaneL, hAkaneH, EV_CHARA_POS_LEFT, [0, 0, 0], "evc0002");
